title: explore the superchain
tagline: a cool onboarding experience to learn and interact with the superchain ecosystem.
description: This project will allow users, especially new to web3, to discover and interact with the superchain ecosystem (op, ethereum, zora, base for now), through a cool 3D website. He will be able to connect, bridge, buy fiat from an on ramp, see transaction between blockchains, stats, etc...
how_its_made:
This project use "create-rainbowkit" template, wagmi, rainbowkit libraries for interacting with a wallet,  next.js, threeJS, three-globe.js libs for the frontend. 
Will hopefully before the deadline use chainlink stack before the end to get info of blockchains interaction, and layerzero tech to bridge between chains. Zora tech to mint an nft on zora chains, base for the same thing.
